headline: Subagents can compact their context earlier
summary: You can make subagents auto-compact earlier than the main conversation.
why_it_matters: Builders can configure when a subagent compacts its context.

zh.headline: 子代理可以提前压缩上下文
zh.summary: 你可以让子代理比主对话更早自动压缩上下文。
zh.why_it_matters: 开发者可以配置子代理压缩上下文的时机。
zh.for_builders: 在子代理 frontmatter 中设置 autoCompactWindow。
